properties.notes: Redevelopment of Cox's Yard for residential development for the provision of 12 flats to be accessed from Rayne Road and one detached dwelling to be accessed from Panfield Lane, including demolition of redundant building, parking, landscaping and amenity areas. Works to 16-18 Rayne Road including replacement of the existing showroom with residential accommodation and a retail frontage, and refurbishment of the existing shop with accommodation over.
